d: We are looking for a proactive and highly organized Executive Assistant to join a dynamic working environment, providing dedicated professional and personal support to a prominent entrepreneur and investor.

The role involves managing day-to-day administrative priorities, coordinating schedules and communications, overseeing follow-ups, and supporting ongoing business initiatives and personal matters. The ideal candidate will be a reliable and resourceful individual who can work independently, anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, and ensure that commitments and responsibilities are handled efficiently.
This position requires a high level of discretion, attention to detail, and the ability to build a trusted working relationship with the executive.
q: 2-3 years of experience in an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, or similar administrative support role
Excellent command of written and spoken English; Arabic proficiency is a strong advantage
Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities effectively
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Proficiency in Google Workspace and Notion
Familiarity with productivity and project management tools is an advantage
Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records and follow up on outstanding matters
Ability to work independently, take initiative, and exercise sound judgment without constant supervision
High levels of professionalism, integrity, discretion, and confidentiality
Adaptability and flexibility when handling changing priorities and both professional and personal responsibilities
Ability to work in a hybrid arrangement, with 2-3 days per week onsite in Bahrain

li

li
Handle sensitive personal and professional information with the highest level of confidentiality and discretion

d: Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

The Manager - Business Planning and Support is responsible for the planning and implementation of projects that support the Sales organization. This role assists the Sales department in providing technical and administrative product information and works with the market research team to ensure market analysis data is used for quoting customer prices. The Manager prepares the distribution of accounts to Sales Representatives and updates the automated tracking system.
All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.
Support Business Planning and Operations (BPO) Head and partner with business development and functional units to achieve organizational goals.
Participate in creation of robust country and functional plans, track and report progress against plans aligned with regular business reviews.
Coordinate collection of relevant data with functional units, business development teams, and management.
Prepare and distribute quarterly market sales performance data and monthly market profitability reports with commentary.
Conduct adhoc analysis such as deep dives into markets, clients, products, and revenue streams to drive new sales efforts and provide business insights.
Participate in the review of actual allocation of resources vs plans and recommend potential reallocations or reprioritization.
Support the creation and management of governance frameworks for leadership teams to review performance through periodic cross-functional meetings.
Champion the internal adoption of Visa CRM tools, support BPO Head in driving usage by publishing data such as opportunities, pipeline dashboards, and account plans.
Lead specific projects for the cluster requiring broad coordination efforts across multiple countries or functional areas.
Build and develop collaborative relationships with multiple partners and clients, and work with Account Executives to identify new opportunities that help grow their business.
Provide regular sales performance reporting to internal stakeholders to support data-driven decision-making and business growth.
q: 5 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD.
Experience in business analysis, strategy, management consulting, payments industry, or financial services.
Experience in financial planning, data analysis, and reporting.

Demonstrated fluency in Generative AI technologies, with a track record of integrating AI-powered tools into business processes to improve productivity, strengthen analytical capabilities, and enable smarter commercial decision-making.

Exceptional project management and execution skills, with experience leading strategic, multi-stakeholder initiatives across markets and functions, driving alignment, prioritization, and successful delivery against business objectives.
Experience in using MS Excel and MS PowerPoint; knowledge of MS Power BI, Tableau, and Business Objects is a plus.
Experience in preparing and distributing sales performance and profitability reports.
Experience in supporting business planning and operations activities.
Experience in coordinating data collection and analysis across multiple teams.
Experience in driving adoption of CRM tools and supporting account planning.
Experience in building collaborative relationships with partners and clients.

6 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 4 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or up to 3 years of relevant experience with a PhD.
Proven experience in Sales and Account Management.
Strong commercial mindset with a demonstrated ability to advance commercial discussions in client-facing roles.
Excellent project management skills, with the ability to drive internal prioritization and meet tight deadlines.
Capacity to understand complex processes and simplify them into clear flowcharts and concepts.
Genuine passion for sales and a strong interest in financial services, especially within payments and technology.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
